title: Neon end crystals
description: Neon tetxures for end crystals and anchors, made to work with the "Aberration" shader but it looks great on it's own!
body:
This texture pack adds neon colouration to ender crystals AND to respawn anchors, giving it a unuiqe theme. This tetxure pack was made to work specifically for the combat shader called "Aberration", but it works really well on it's own too!



Warning: This pack(and the shader it was made to work with) includes flashing lights and strong visual effects that may be uncomfortable for some users. Please use responsibly.
